fp32.c_abs.rule: A[:,0] = B[0,:] = 2^50 (a k = 0 product of 2^100), every other element 1.0: constant operands, a frozen accumulator (each 1.0 product is below half an ulp of (n+1) 2^100)

fp32.r_walk.rule: A[:,0] = B[0,:] = 1.0; A[:,1:], B[1:,:] = |N(0,1)| in fp32 (seed 8801): random positive operands, the accumulators walk and differ from each other

fp32.r_abs.rule: r_walk's operands with r_walk's k = 0 slice replaced by 2^50 x 2^50: the same multiplier inputs on 15 of 16 k-groups, every later product absorbed, a frozen accumulator equal in every C element

fp32.r_het.rule: r_abs with B[0, j] = 2^50 m_j, m_j in [1, 2) with 23 random bits (seed 8803): the accumulators frozen but different from each other, so the C read and the result bus swing between the two C elements a lane alternates between

fp32.s_walk.rule: A[:,0] = B[0,:] = 1.0; A[:,1:], B[1:,:] = +-1.0, random signs (seed 8802): only sign bits move, the accumulators walk by +-1

fp32.s_abs.rule: s_walk's signs with the k = 0 slice 2^50 x 2^50: sign bits move, every +-1 product absorbed

fp16.c_cancel.rule: A words (1, 1), B words (1, -1): each micro-op adds 1 - 1 = 0, constant operands, C frozen at +0

fp16.r_walk.rule: A words (x, x), x = |N(0,1)| fp16; B words (u, -u'), u and u' independent |N(0,1)| (seed 8811); k-group 0 = c_cancel's (1, 1) x (1, -1): the accumulators walk

fp16.r_cancel.rule: r_walk's A and u with B words (u, -u): x u - x u = 0 in every micro-op, C frozen at +0

fp16.r_abs.rule: r_walk's operands with k-group 0 = (2^15, 2^15) x (2^15, 2^15): 2^31 per op, every later dot product absorbed (|x (u - u')| < 2^5 < 2^7 = half an ulp)

int8.c_cancel.rule: A bytes 1, B bytes (1, -1, 1, -1) in every word: each micro-op adds 0, C frozen at 0

int8.r_walk.rule: A words (x, x, y, y), x, y uniform in [-128, 127]; B words (u, -u', v, -v'), u, u', v, v' uniform in [-127, 127], all independent (seed 8821): the int32 accumulators walk

int8.r_cancel.rule: r_walk's A, u and v with B words (u, -u, v, -v): x u - x u + y v - y v = 0, C frozen at 0

fp32.zeros.rule: every element +0.0 (0x00000000): every lane gated on an accumulate pass

fp16.randn.rule: standard normal, sigma 1, rounded to fp16

int8.full.rule: uniform over -128..127, the whole two's-complement range (E64's int8 `randn`)
